    (htcone : t ≤ (H.levels.params (i+1)).columns * F.coeffSize (F.core v)) :

    F.coeffSize v ≤ (H.levels.params (i+1)).columns * F.coeffSize u ∧
    F.coeffSize u ≤ (H.levels.params (i+1)).columns * ((H.S.block i).val : ℝ)^d *
        F.coeffSize v := by
